Name: Spouse Home Activities - Add-on for Valley Girls
Author: TNTpocket
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
An unofficial add-on for Valley Girls that gives all supported stay-at-home spouses independent hourly checks for home activities, using their matching Valley Girls animations and dialogue.
Each spouse is checked separately and can trigger an activity once per day.
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Valley Girls.[/*]
[*]Extract this mod into your

[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Delete the old PennyHomeActivity mod first if it is installed.[/*]
[/list][heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Supports all Valley Girls spouses listed below.[/*]
[*]Performs independent hourly activity checks for each spouse.[/*]
[*]Allows each spouse to trigger an activity once per day.[/*]
[*]Configurable activity hours and trigger chance.[/*]
[*]Supports Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*]Includes English and Chinese configuration text.[/*]
[/list][heading]Supported Spouses[/heading]
[list]
[*]Abigail[/*]
[*]Caroline[/*]
[*]Emily[/*]
[*]Haley[/*]
[*]Jodi[/*]
[*]Leah[/*]
[*]Marnie[/*]
[*]Maru[/*]
[*]Penny[/*]
[*]Robin[/*]
[/list]Abigail, Emily, Haley, Leah, Maru, and Penny work as normal vanilla spouses.
Caroline, Jodi, Marnie, and Robin require a separate marriage mod that correctly registers the NPC as the current player's spouse. Mods that only change dialogue, spouse rooms, or relationship labels may not work.
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Valley Girls[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu — optional[/*]
[/list][heading]Credits[/heading]
Thanks to the creator of Valley Girls for the original animations and content.
This is an unofficial add-on and does not redistribute any Valley Girls assets.
